info.title: PRISM audit review API
info.description: Callable backend endpoints only, with schemas from the FastAPI application. Use this document for frontend client generation. Examples are independent synthetic snapshots.

get.description: Omit filters to include every sample in original audit order. total and next_offset refer to the filtered queue. Processing state, incomplete flag, machine outcomes and human decisions are separate. Queued/running samples are pending; otherwise fail takes precedence over unsure, then unavailable. Failed/cancelled/incomplete or zero-findings samples cannot be no_issue. No automatic acceptance. Snapshot-backed samples with an available captured original image advertise a revision-pinned thumbnail_url; legacy samples without a manifest association keep it null. Missing audits return 404, empty matching pages return 200.

get.summary: Read sample findings, evidence and measurements
get.description: One database snapshot includes the stored sample pin, exact captured manifest availability, original measurements, all findings with latest reviews, technical failures and current sample decision. Snapshot-backed samples advertise image/thumbnail links when original_image is available and mask/mask_preview links when raw_mask is available; recorded missing or unreadable roles and legacy samples without a manifest association remain null. Links advertise captured availability only: the asset route verifies exact bytes and derived previews may reject corrupt or unsupported sources. Measurements are null when not persisted and otherwise preserve the collector document (including its original pending_review field), except that loading-error details use safe messages even for legacy reports. Stored evidence is not rewritten. No current dataset files are read or latest revision inferred. Missing audit/sample returns 404.

get.summary: Download a revision-pinned image or mask asset
get.description: Returns image/png for exactly the requested revision with X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. image and mask return exact captured bytes after size and SHA-256 verification, including malformed source bytes retained for inspection; no raw mask decoding or conversion occurs. Stored content-type metadata cannot select a different response type. thumbnail and mask_preview are derived display PNGs; previews never replace raw mask bytes and may reject corrupt or unsupported sources with ASSET_NOT_RENDERABLE. All four kinds enforce a 64 MiB source-byte limit and return ASSET_TOO_LARGE when exceeded. Missing or unavailable assets return a JSON error, and integrity, storage-configuration and unexpected failures retain the documented JSON error envelope. No latest-revision lookup or private storage path is exposed.

post.summary: Queue a durable dataset ZIP import
post.description: Send exactly archive, name and format=penn_fudan using multipart FormData, not JSON. Let the browser set its boundary. 202 acknowledges closed durable staging plus committed dataset/job/request, not import completion. Poll the shared job route. ZIP layout/CRC/identity failures after acceptance belong to dataset/job state, not an HTTP validation response. Unknown commit outcome is unresolved, never a fabricated 202 or an automatic replay.

get.summary: Poll persisted job progress and completion
get.description: Read the persisted public Job resource without claiming, executing, recovering or modifying work. Return HTTP 200 for queued, running, cancelling, completed, failed and cancelled states. progress.total and progress.fraction may be null when work is indeterminate; result and error are nullable. Failed jobs remain HTTP 200 with their structured error in the response, not an HTTP failure. Preserve result.href exactly when present; the audit result destination /api/v1/audits/{audit_id} is callable. Missing jobs return 404; invalid identifiers return 422; storage and unexpected failures use the shared safe 503/500 envelopes. Worker identity, claim tokens, leases, attempts and resource columns are never public.

post.description: Accept no request body and return HTTP 202 with the public Job resource. For a queued audit, the existing transactional repository operation immediately marks the job cancelled, updates the audit and queued samples, and may preserve its stored result link. For a running audit, return cancelling while the worker reaches a safe boundary; repeated requests while cancelling preserve that state. Completed, failed and already-cancelled jobs return 409 JOB_ALREADY_FINISHED. Missing jobs return 404; invalid identifiers return 422; storage and unexpected failures use the shared safe 503/500 envelopes. Worker identity, claim tokens, leases, attempts and resource columns are never public. Cancellation does not rewrite completed measurements, findings or reviewer decisions.

put.description: Separate from finding resolution. Reviewer controls accepted/rejected/needs_correction decisions, including no_issue or no-findings samples; pending_review explicitly reopens review with attribution. Completed samples (including incomplete measurements) and failed samples are eligible regardless of parent audit status; queued/running/cancelled samples return 409 INVALID_SAMPLE_REVIEW_STATE. expected_sample_revision must identify a stored pin for this audit/sample, otherwise 409 STALE_SAMPLE_REVISION (404 if the audit/sample is missing). It does not check current dataset files: snapshot-backed audits use immutable captured assets; legacy audits use live files. Application-owned revision selection and correction workflows remain planned. expected_review_version is the last-read review revision, starting at 0; each decision advances it by one. A stale review revision returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT. Machine evidence, failures, progress and finding resolutions stay unchanged.

post.summary: Propose draft rules from plain text
post.description: Durably accept exact nonblank plain text without inline inference or a placeholder book. HTTP 202 does not establish worker readiness. Start the extraction worker separately. Poll GET /jobs/{job_id}; every state, including failed, remains HTTP 200. One processing attempt only; stale attempts fail without replay. Completion publishes one version-1 extracted/draft rulebook, empty review history and a result.href pinned with ?version=1. Existing cancellation route is supported; cancelled jobs publish no output. Errors are safe job.error codes, not retrospective submission errors. See EXTRACTIONS.md for error mapping, finite deadlines and operator workflow.

post.description: Manually create a version-1 draft with server-assigned ID, reviewer origin and draft states. Exact guideline text is preserved; non-null citations must match exactly. Rules may be empty or omitted, and guideline_text may be empty. Unknown fields and client attempts to supply server metadata are rejected with safe 422 VALIDATION_ERROR. Unsupported or null checks remain for human review without inferred thresholds. Initial review history is empty; creation does not confirm rules, call a model or start jobs/audits. Separate successful POST requests create separate books, without automatic retries or idempotency. A generated-ID collision returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT without overwriting or appending a version. Storage/commit failures return safe 503, and unexpected internal validation/response defects remain 500.

Finding.description:
One rule's outcome against a pinned sample revision and rulebook version.

Rule content is copied into the finding so evidence remains understandable
after later edits. object_id is absent for sample-wide findings and may be
nonpositive when reporting invalid source annotation IDs. The evaluator
owns rulebook confirmation, source matching and reason selection. Extracted
findings require a source sentence; reviewer-authored findings may omit it.
